title.rendered: Visit to Saidpur Fecal Sludge Treatment Plant | Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur

content.rendered:
𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗹-𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿 𝘀𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 of the 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿, visited the 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 𝗙𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁 (𝗙𝗦𝗧𝗣) on 𝟵 𝗦𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲, accompanied by faculty members, including 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳. 𝗗𝗿. 𝗠𝗱. 𝗠𝗮𝗵𝗺𝘂𝗱𝘂𝗹 𝗛𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗻, 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘆.
The visit aimed to connect students’ 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗹𝗲𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹-𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲, providing practical exposure to 𝗳𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, 𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗰𝗼-𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴, and 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆, particularly in relation to 𝗖𝗘 𝟰𝟭𝟰𝟭: 𝗪𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗦𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻. During the visit, students observed the plant’s treatment units and learned about the 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, 𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, and 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲.
Operational since 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟭, the plant is managed under 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 𝗠𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, with technical support from 𝗕𝗔𝗦𝗔 𝗙𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 and 𝗪𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗔𝗶𝗱. It can treat up to 𝟮𝟲 𝗺³ 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘆 and produces approximately 𝟭𝟯𝟮 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰 𝘁𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆. The facility also incorporates 𝘀𝗼𝗹𝗮𝗿 𝗽𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿 and 𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗵𝗮𝗿𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴, contributing to sustainable sanitation and waste management in Saidpur.
The visit strengthened students’ understanding of 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝘀𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗳𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗿 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, and 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆.
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 | 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔–𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕

𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟕𝟔𝟗𝟔𝟔𝟐𝟕𝟐𝟎 𝐨𝐫 +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟖𝟏𝟒𝟕𝟓𝟓𝟒𝟒𝟎

title.rendered: BAUST CE Alumni Talk 2026 | Stories, Insights & Career Experiences

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, is delighted to invite all current undergraduate and graduate students of BAUST CE to join us for an inspiring evening of stories, insights, and real-world experiences from our accomplished alumni.
What can you expect?
Discover how their BAUST academic journey, engineering education, skills, and experiences helped shape their professional careers and guided them toward becoming successful engineers. Learn from their challenges, achievements, career pathways, and valuable advice for your own future.
Featuring:
Md. Abu Helal — Assistant Engineer, LGED
Zubair Reaz — Assistant Engineer, DATAMS Consultancy Limited
Urnisha Roy Chowdhury — Design Coordinator, M/S Khosheda Enterprise
Host: Ahasanul Haque Hashib, Lecturer, Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST
Date: Today, 15 September 2026
Time: 10:00 PM BDT
Platform: Official BAUST Civil Engineering Facebook Page
Facebook Live
Don’t miss this opportunity to connect with our alumni, gain practical career insights, and discover how your BAUST degree can shape your journey toward professional success.
Let’s learn from their experiences and build a stronger tomorrow together!

content.rendered:
The 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗜𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗖𝗹𝘂𝗯 (𝗖𝗘𝗜𝗖), 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 successfully organized the 𝗤𝘂𝗶𝘇 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, bringing together undergraduate students of the 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴.
A fun platform to challenge 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗹𝗲𝗱𝗴𝗲, 𝗹𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴, and 𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗜𝗤.
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 | 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔–𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕
𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟕𝟔𝟗𝟔𝟔𝟐𝟕𝟐𝟎 𝐨𝐫 +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟖𝟏𝟒𝟕𝟓𝟓𝟒𝟒𝟎

A fun platform to challenge 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗹𝗲𝗱𝗴𝗲, 𝗹𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴, and 𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗜𝗤. 𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 | 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔–𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟕𝟔𝟗𝟔𝟔𝟐𝟕𝟐𝟎 𝐨𝐫 +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟖𝟏𝟒𝟕𝟓𝟓𝟒𝟒𝟎

title.rendered: Academic Result Analysis | 6 September, 2026

content.rendered:
The faculty members of the 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿, held a meeting with the 𝗛𝗼𝗻𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿, 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗴 𝗚𝗲𝗻 𝗠𝗼𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗱 𝗠𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗸 𝗛𝗼𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗷𝘂𝗺𝗱𝗲𝗿, 𝗽𝘀𝗰, to review the department’s 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, and areas requiring further improvement.
The discussion focused on strengthening 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, enhancing 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, and ensuring 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗴𝘂𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 for students. These collaborative efforts reflect the department’s commitment to 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘂𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 and fostering a more 𝗲𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗲𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁.
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 | 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔–𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕
𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟕𝟔𝟗𝟔𝟔𝟐𝟕𝟐𝟎 𝐨𝐫 +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟖𝟏𝟒𝟕𝟓𝟓𝟒𝟒𝟎

title.rendered: Official Announcement: Executive Committee (Student Panel) — Summer 2026

content.rendered:
The Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC), Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, proudly unveils the newly recommended Executive Committee (Student Panel) for the Summer 2026 session.
Led by Shakh Sadik Rahbar (President), Tasnim Tabassum Sneha (Vice-President), and Md. Fahim Fahad (General Secretary), alongside an energetic team of student leaders representing Batches 17 through 21 across finance, event management, planning, competitions, and media, this panel is dedicated to driving collaboration, creativity, and student empowerment. We congratulate all the members taking up their respective responsibilities and look forward to an inspiring session filled with successful endeavors and shared milestones.

title.rendered: Official Announcement: Faculty Advisory Board (Summer 2026)

content.rendered:
The Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC), Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, is deeply honored to announce its Faculty Advisory Board for the Summer 2026 session.
Under the visionary guidance of our Chief Advisor, Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan (Dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering; Professor & Head, Dept. of CE), alongside our esteemed Advisor, Md. Kamrul Hasan Kawsar (Lecturer, Dept. of CE), and Co-Advisor, Punom Roy (Lecturer, Dept. of CE), the club continues its mission to foster academic excellence, technical innovation, and professional growth. We express our heartfelt gratitude to our respected mentors for their constant support and leadership as we embark on another impactful journey together.

Ready to explore how 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 is transforming the field of Civil Engineering?
The 𝐄𝐧𝐯𝐢𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐒𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐂𝐥𝐮𝐛 (𝐄𝐒𝐂) and 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐈𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐂𝐥𝐮𝐛 (𝐂𝐄𝐈𝐂), 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫, are jointly organizing an exciting 𝐨𝐧𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐩 focused on practical applications of Machine Learning in Civil Engineering.
𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫: Md Zahim Hassan, Lecturer, Department of CSE, BAUST, Saidpur
𝐏𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦: Zoom
𝐑𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐞𝐞: 𝟒𝟗𝟗 𝐁𝐃𝐓
𝐅𝐨𝐜𝐮𝐬 𝐀𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬: Structural Health Monitoring, Predictive Maintenance, Construction Management, Geotechnical Analysis & Environmental Modeling
𝗥𝗲𝗴𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗸: https://forms.gle/dZfcfeZtx2jGuMGTA
𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞: 03 September 2026, by 6:00 PM
Register now and take the next step toward becoming a 𝐟𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞-𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫!
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 | 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔–𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕

title.rendered: বিএইউএসটি, সৈয়দপুরে ১৯তম একাডেমিক কাউন্সিল সভা অনুষ্ঠিত সৈয়দপুর, নীলফামারী

content.rendered:
সৈয়দপুরে অবস্থিত বাংলাদেশ আর্মি ইউনিভার্সিটি অব সায়েন্স এন্ড টেকনোলজি (বিএইউএসটি), সৈয়দপুর এর একাডেমিক কাউন্সিলের ১৯তম সভা আজ ২৪ আগস্ট ২০২৬ (সোমবার) সকাল ১০:০০টায় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের সভাকক্ষে অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে।
সভায় সভাপতিত্ব করেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের মাননীয় উপাচার্য ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোহাম্মদ মোবারক হোসেন মজুমদার, পিএসসি। সভার শুরুতে সভাপতি মহোদয় স্বাগত বক্তব্য প্রদান করেন। এরপর বিদায়ী সদস্যকে ধন্যবাদ জ্ঞাপন এবং নবনিযুক্ত সদস্যদের অভিনন্দন জানানো হয়। পাশাপাশি ১৮তম সভার কার্যবিবরণী নিশ্চিত করা হয়।
১৯তম সভায় মোট ১৬টি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ আলোচ্যসূচি নিয়ে বিস্তারিত আলোচনা করা হয়। একাডেমিক কার্যক্রমের উন্নয়ন, শিক্ষার মানোন্নয়ন, পাঠ্যক্রম সংক্রান্ত বিষয় এবং প্রশাসনিক বিভিন্ন দিক নিয়ে সভায় গঠনমূলক আলোচনা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।
২১ সদস্যবিশিষ্ট এ কমিটির সভাপতি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন উপাচার্য ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোহাম্মদ মোবারক হোসেন মজুমদার, পিএসসি। সম্মানিত সদস্য হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোঃ মাহবুবুল হক, এনডিসি, এএফডব্লিউসি, পিএসসি, কমান্ড্যান্ট, ইএমই সেন্টার এন্ড স্কুল, সৈয়দপুর সেনানিবাস। সভায় সদস্য সচিব হিসেবে দায়িত্ব পালন করেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের রেজিস্ট্রার কর্নেল চৌধুরী সাইফ উদ্দিন কাউসার, পিবিজিএম (অবঃ)।
এছাড়াও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের সকল অনুষদের ডীনবৃন্দ, বিভাগীয় প্রধানগণ ও জৈষ্ঠ্যতার ভিত্তিতে সিএসই বিভাগের একজন অধ্যাপক সভায় সদস্য হিসেবে অংশগ্রহণ করেন।
চারজন এক্সটার্নাল সদস্য অনলাইনের মাধ্যমে সভায় যুক্ত ছিলেন। তারা হলেন—
অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ আলী (এমই বিভাগ, বুয়েট), অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ মাসরুর আলী (সিএসই বিভাগ, বুয়েট), অধ্যাপক ড. মোঃ আয়নাল হক (ইইই বিভাগ, বুয়েট) এবং অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ তৌফিকুল ইসলাম (ব্যবস্থাপনা বিভাগ, ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়)।
সভায় গৃহীত সিদ্ধান্তসমূহ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের একাডেমিক কার্যক্রমকে আরও গতিশীল ও মানসম্মত করতে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখবে বলে আশা প্রকাশ করা হয়।
————-
ধন্যবাদান্তে,
মোঃ শাহ্ আলম
জনসংযোগ কর্মকর্তা
বিএইউএসটি, সৈয়দপুর

title.rendered: Practical Field Survey for the Proposed G+6 Administrative Building at BAUST, Saidpur

content.rendered:
The 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 conducted a practical field survey at the proposed site of the 𝗚+𝟲 𝗔𝗱𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 at the new campus.
The field survey provided 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐮𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 with a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in 𝘀𝘂𝗿𝘃𝗲𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴, bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world engineering practice. The students received practical training in the use of an 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹, including instrument setup and operation, leveling procedures, staff reading, the use of ranging rods, and other essential field surveying techniques.
Throughout the survey, 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘀 and members of the 𝘁𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 provided guidance and technical support, ensuring the successful execution of the surveying and leveling activities.
Such practical field exposure enhances students’ 𝘁𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲, and 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴, preparing them for the challenges of real-world civil engineering practice.
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 -𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕

title.rendered: The Final Battle: Who Will Win the Trophy?  1st Intra Civil Cricket Tournament 2026 — Grand Finale

content.rendered:
The wait is almost over. After days of thrilling cricket, fierce competition, teamwork, and unforgettable moments, the 𝟏𝐬𝐭 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐚 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐂𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐭 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 is heading towards its grand finale.
Before the ultimate championship battle, we have something special in store.
𝐅𝐀𝐂𝐔𝐋𝐓𝐘 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐀𝐋𝐔𝐌𝐍𝐈 𝐕𝐒 𝐀𝐋𝐋 𝐒𝐓𝐔𝐃𝐄𝐍𝐓𝐒
A special exhibition match where experience meets youthful energy. Will our respected Faculty and Alumni prevail, or will the students prove that the next generation has arrived?
𝟐𝟒 𝐀𝐮𝐠𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔
𝟒:𝟑𝟎 𝐏𝐌 — Faculty and Alumni vs Students
And then comes the moment we have all been waiting for.
𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐅𝐈𝐍𝐀𝐋
𝟓:𝟏𝟓 𝐏𝐌 — 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐞 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝟐𝟏 𝐕𝐒 𝐓𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐬 𝟏𝟖, 𝟏𝟗, 𝟐𝟎
Before the final, join us for the 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐩𝐡𝐲 𝐔𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐲 at 𝟒:𝟎𝟎 𝐏𝐌 and witness the unveiling of the coveted championship trophy.
Come and be part of this spectacular closing day as we celebrate cricket, camaraderie, sportsmanship, and the spirit of Civil Engineering.
𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞. 𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐩𝐢𝐨𝐧. 𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐮𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐝𝐚𝐲.
𝐖𝐇𝐎 𝐖𝐈𝐋𝐋 𝐋𝐈𝐅𝐓 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐓𝐑𝐎𝐏𝐇𝐘?
See you at the ground.
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 -𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕
𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: +𝟖𝟖𝟎𝟏𝟕𝟔𝟗𝟔𝟔𝟐𝟕𝟐𝟎

title.rendered: 1st Round Victory | 3rd Inter-Department Debate Competition

content.rendered:
The 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐃𝐞𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐨𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐭𝐲 organized the 3rd Inter-Department Debate Competition in the 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐲 𝐃𝐞𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐞 format.
𝐌𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: “This House believes that a special ‘Congestion Tax’ should be imposed on the use of private vehicles to reduce traffic congestion in major cities.”
𝗥𝗲𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝘃𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟭𝘀𝘁 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱!
𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 to 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐝𝐞𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬 for their strong arguments, confident delivery, and outstanding performance.
𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐧 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 -𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕

title.rendered: বিতর্কের বিষয়: যানজট কমাতে ব্যক্তিগত গাড়ির ওপর “Congestion Tax” — কার্যকর সমাধান নাকি বাড়তি চাপ?

content.rendered:
শহর বড় হচ্ছে, গাড়ি বাড়ছে—আর বাড়ছে যানজটও।
তাহলে যানজট কমাতে ব্যক্তিগত গাড়ির ওপর বিশেষ “Congestion Tax” কি হতে পারে কার্যকর সমাধান?
নাকি এটি সাধারণ মানুষের ওপর বাড়তি চাপ?
দুই দলের যুক্তি, পাল্টা যুক্তি আর তর্কের মধ্য দিয়ে খুঁজে নেওয়া হবে উত্তরের পথ।
“এই সংসদ মনে করে যে, বড় শহরগুলোতে যানজট কমাতে ব্যক্তিগত গাড়ি ব্যবহারের ওপর বিশেষ ‘Congestion Tax’ আরোপ করা উচিত।”
সরকারি দল: Civil Engineering
বিরোধী দল: Information & Communication Technology
তারিখ: ২২ আগস্ট, শনিবার
সময়: বিকেল ৪:৪৫ ঘটিকা
স্থান: BAUST Seminar Hall

কার যুক্তি হবে বেশি শক্তিশালী—Government নাকি Opposition?
দেখা হবে বিতর্কের মঞ্চে।

title.rendered: Strengthening Academia–Industry Collaboration

content.rendered:
The 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫, was honored to welcome 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐫. 𝐓𝐚𝐬𝐧𝐢𝐚 𝐓𝐚𝐬𝐦𝐢𝐦 𝐒𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚, Sub-Divisional Engineer, 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 (𝐑𝐇𝐃), Nilphamari.
As the Industry Advisor of the industrial attachment course, Engr. Tasnia Tasmim Sinthia made a courtesy visit to the high officials of BAUST, including the 𝐕𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐫 𝐁𝐫𝐢𝐠 𝐆𝐞𝐧 𝐌𝐨𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐝 𝐌𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐤 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐚𝐣𝐮𝐦𝐝𝐞𝐫, 𝐑𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐫 𝐂𝐨𝐥 𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐰𝐝𝐡𝐮𝐫𝐲 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐟 𝐔𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐧 𝐊𝐚𝐰𝐬𝐚𝐫, 𝐏𝐁𝐆𝐌, 𝐒𝐢𝐠𝐬 (𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐝), 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟. 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧.
During the visit, the Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur presented a token of appreciation to her in recognition of her valuable time, dedicated mentorship, professional guidance, and sincere support throughout the students’ industrial attachment.
Her involvement provided the students with an important connection between academic learning and real-world engineering practice. The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur sincerely appreciates her contribution and remains committed to fostering strong academia–industry collaboration to prepare competent, confident, and industry-ready civil engineers.

title.rendered: Final Presentation and Viva of the Industrial Attachment Course (CE 4170) | Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, successfully concluded the Final Presentation and Viva of the Industrial Attachment Course (CE 4170) for the 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥-𝟒, 𝐓𝐞𝐫𝐦-𝐈 students of the 𝐂𝐄 𝟏𝟕𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡, titled “Bridging Theory and Practice: Insights from Industrial Attachment.”
The 𝐭𝐰𝐨-𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐤 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐀𝐭𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 concluded with students presenting their key learnings and professional experiences gained from three major government organizations: the Roads and Highways Department (RHD), Public Works Department (PWD), and Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB).
The program was graced by the presence of 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟. 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Lecturer Ahasanul Haque Hashib, Industrial Attachment Coordinator, respected Industry Advisor, faculty members, and students of the department.
Prof. Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan and the Industry Advisor, Tanisa Tasmim Sinthia, SDE, RHD, Nilphamari, shared valuable insights and guidance with the students, emphasizing technical competence, professional ethics, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving skills.
The Department sincerely appreciates the Industry Advisor, faculty members, coordinators, and students for their valuable contributions in making the program successful.

title.rendered: 1st Intra Civil Cricket Tournament 2026 — Opening Day.

content.rendered:
The 𝟏𝐬𝐭 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐚 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐂𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐭 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔, organized by the 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫, officially kicked off today with an exciting and memorable opening ceremony.
The ceremony was graced by the presence of 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟. 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering and head of the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur along with respected faculty members and our distinguished alumni.
The tournament was officially inaugurated by Hon’ble Dean Sir with the first batting of the tournament. In his address, he emphasized the importance of engaging in regular sports and physical activities alongside academic pursuits.
Following the inauguration, 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐩-𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬 were successfully conducted by the organizers, bringing together students, faculty members, and alumni in an atmosphere of enthusiasm and camaraderie.
It was truly a wonderful day filled with sportsmanship, excitement, teamwork, and thrilling moments. We look forward to many more memorable matches in the days ahead!

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur is pleased to announce its 1st Intra CE Cricket Tournament, 2026.
Students from different batches, along with respected faculty members, will take part in this exciting event, promoting teamwork, sportsmanship, discipline, and healthy competition.
𝐎𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡: 19 August 2026
𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞: 4:00 PM
𝐕𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞: BAUST, Saidpur Central Field
Join us to support your teams and make this tournament enjoyable, memorable, and full of sporting spirit.

title.rendered: 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐬 𝐎𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐅𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥 & 𝟏𝟎𝟎% 𝐀𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐂𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐲

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, organized a combined Orientation Program for the 23rd Batch, Farewell Program for the 15th Batch, and Prize Giving Ceremony for 100% Class Attendance on 16 August, 2026 at the Seminar Hall.
The program was graced by 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐨𝐫 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering as the Chief Guest.
The 𝟐𝟑𝐫𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 was warmly welcomed with flowers and gifts as they began their journey at BAUST,Saidpur. Representatives of the batch shared their feelings, expectations, and positive first impressions of the department, expressing confidence in the supportive academic environment and guidance of their teachers and seniors.
The 𝟏𝟓𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡, marking the completion of their undergraduate journey, shared heartfelt experiences and gratitude toward the department. They advised their juniors to remain attentive in class, develop practical knowledge, strengthen their technical skills, and learn relevant engineering software to prepare themselves for a successful professional career. Farewell crests were presented to the graduating students as a token of appreciation and remembrance.
A total of 𝟏𝟒 𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 were recognized for achieving 𝟏𝟎𝟎% 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 and received certificates and prizes in appreciation of their discipline, commitment, and dedication to academic life. One of the awardees shared their experience, highlighting how regular attendance contributes to better understanding of courses, stronger relationships with peers, and greater confidence in academic activities.
In speech, the Chief Guest Prof. Dr. Mahmud welcomed the new students and encouraged them to focus on academic excellence while developing discipline, integrity, ethical values, and professional responsibility. He reminded the graduating students that knowledge and skills must always be accompanied by honesty and moral values, particularly in civil engineering, where professional decisions directly affect people’s safety and the nation’s infrastructure.
Finally the program concluded with a joyful photo session, capturing memorable moments of the day. Special thanks to our students, Md. Jahid Hasan (Level 4, Term II) and Samprite Saha (Level 3, Term I), for their excellent anchoring and enthusiastic contribution to the program.

title.rendered: BAUST Civil Engineering & PWD Nilphamari — bridging classroom learning with practical knowledge, exposure, and experience.

content.rendered:
As part of the Industrial Attachment Program 2026, students from the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, have successfully completed their office and field activities with the Public Works Department (PWD), Nilphamari.

The attachment provided the students with valuable practical experience in ongoing building construction, masonry works, construction materials, site supervision, project planning, and technical documentation. Through visits to active construction sites and interactions with PWD engineers, officials, and field personnel, the students were able to connect their academic knowledge with real-world engineering practices.

The Department sincerely appreciates the PWD officials, engineers, and field personnel for their continuous guidance, supervision, and valuable knowledge-sharing throughout the attachment.

title.rendered: Our Alumni, Our Pride: Congratulations on Your MBA Achievement

content.rendered: 𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐀𝐥𝐮𝐦𝐧𝐢, 𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐞 The 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫 proudly congratulates our esteemed alumnus, 𝐒𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐤𝐡 𝐊𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐫𝐮𝐳𝐳𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐧 (𝟏𝟎𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 – 𝟏𝐬𝐭 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐄), on successfully completing his Master of Business Administration (MBA) from the 𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐖𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐓𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐭 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝, 𝐋𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐧. Your achievement is a proud milestone for our department and an inspiration to our students. Wishing you continued success, growth, and excellence in all your future endeavors.

title.rendered: BAUST Civil Engineering Students Begin Industrial Attachment at Leading Government Engineering Organizations

content.rendered: The Department of Civil Engineering (BAUST), Saidpur is proud to place its Level-4, Term-I students at three of the most renowned government engineering organisations as part of the Industrial Attachment Program. The organisation’s are: 🛣️ Roads and Highways Department (RHD) 🏗️ Public Works Department (PWD) 🌊 Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB) As part of the Outcome-Based Education (OBE) curriculum this two-week intensive industrial training is designed to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and professional engineering practice by providing students with valuable hands-on experience and direct exposure to real-world infrastructure projects. Through close interaction with practicing engineers and participation in field activities, students can gain practical insights into project planning, design, construction, quality control, and engineering management—preparing them to become competent, ethical, and industry-ready professionals. At BAUST, we firmly believe that engineering education extends far beyond the classroom. By fostering strong partnerships with leading government organizations, we ensure that our students graduate not only with sound theoretical knowledge but also with the practical skills, professional ethics, and confidence required to address the engineering challenges of today or tomorrow.

title.rendered: Building Future Engineers: Thesis Pre-Defense Session Held at BAUST, Civil Engineering Department

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, successfully conducted the 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝐏𝐫𝐞-𝐃𝐞𝐟𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 for the students of the 4-I Semester. This important academic event provided a platform for students to present their research ideas and proposed thesis plans before faculty members and fellow students.
During the session, the faculty members offered valuable feedback, constructive criticism, and expert guidance to help students refine their research methodologies and strengthen the quality of their work for future publications and real-world applications.
The proposed research topics showcased the students’ commitment to addressing contemporary engineering and environmental challenges, including:
1. Groundwater potential mapping using GIS in Nilphamari District to support future water resource planning amid rapid urbanization.
2. Sustainable utilization of recycled ceramic tiles in concrete production to reduce environmental impacts and promote greener construction practices.
3. Investigation of natural soil as landfill liner material to prevent groundwater contamination from waste leachate.
4. Eco-friendly pavement construction using jute fiber as a sustainable reinforcement material.
5. Numerical simulation of soil-structure interaction under earthquake loading for resilient infrastructure development.
6. Assessment of seismic performance of buildings with soft-story irregularities caused by open parking floors.
7. Recycling and reuse of asphalt pavement materials for sustainable transportation infrastructure.
The Department proudly applauds the enthusiasm, creativity, and research potential demonstrated by the students. We extend our sincere appreciation to 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean (In-Charge) and Head of the Department, as well as the faculty members, for their continuous mentorship and support in fostering a strong research culture at BAUST, Saidpur.

title.rendered: BAUST Creative Minds Expo 2.0: Inspiring Innovation for a Sustainable Future

content.rendered:
𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐨 𝟐.𝟎
Organized by IQAC, BAUST, Saidpur, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐨 𝟐.𝟎 brought together innovation, creativity, and engineering excellence under one roof. The event showcased over 100 projects from various engineering departments, providing students with an outstanding platform to demonstrate their technical expertise, innovative thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
We extend our sincere gratitude to the honorable Vice Chancellor, BAUST, Saidpur, 𝐁𝐫𝐢𝐠 𝐆𝐞𝐧 𝐌𝐨𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐝 𝐌𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐤 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐚𝐣𝐮𝐦𝐝𝐞𝐫, psc, for his active engagement and continuous support, which consistently inspire students to pursue innovation and excellence. We also thank 𝐈𝐐𝐀𝐂, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫 for successfully organizing this remarkable event and providing a platform for student creativity and innovation.
Among the showcased projects was 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭, presented by a team of students of the 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫. Pervious concrete is a sustainable pavement material containing interconnected voids that allow rainwater to infiltrate through the pavement surface, thereby reducing stormwater runoff and promoting groundwater recharge. Such innovative solutions highlight the vital role of engineering in advancing sustainable infrastructure and environmental stewardship.
BAUST Creative Minds Expo 2.0 was more than an exhibition. It was a celebration of innovation and a testament to the ingenuity, dedication, and potential of the next generation of engineers.

title.rendered: Board Viva Organized by Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur

content.rendered:
The Board Viva of Level-3 and Level-4 students of the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur was successfully held today through two separate boards. Board-1 was chaired by Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean in Charge and Head of the Department, while Board-2 was chaired by Kh. Shihab Uddin Ahmed, Faculty Member of the Department. All faculty members of the department actively participated in both boards.
The session provided students an opportunity to present their academic knowledge and technical competencies. The department extends best wishes to all students for their future success.

title.rendered: Prize Giving Ceremony of AutoCAD & Waste to Wealth Competitions Successfully Held at BAUST, Saidpur

content.rendered:
Successfully organized the combined Prize Giving Ceremony of the AutoCAD Competition by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) and the Waste to Wealth Competition by the Environment & Sustainability Club (ESC).
The Department of Civil Engineering at BAUST, Saidpur always encourages students to apply practical knowledge beyond textbooks. AutoCAD is one of the most significant software tools in Civil Engineering for planning and design purposes. On the other hand, waste generation is increasing rapidly worldwide. Therefore, recycling and reusing waste materials by transforming them into valuable products has become very important. Through the Waste to Wealth competition, students gained knowledge, creativity, and environmental awareness by developing innovative projects from waste materials.
A special thanks goes to 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean (In-Charge) & Head of the department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur for his continuous guidance not only in academic fields but also in extracurricular activities. We are also grateful to him for delivering his valuable speech at the event.
Many thanks to the club advisors, respected faculty members, club members, and all participants for making this event successful.
And warm congratulations to all the winners for their outstanding achievements.

content.rendered:
A seminar on earthquake risk and mitigation was held at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, on Wednesday, 20 May. The seminar, titled “Earthquake Risk Scenario: Bangladesh Perspective, BNBC-2020 and Mitigation Measure,” was organized by the Department of Civil Engineering at the university’s seminar hall.
The chief guest of the program was Brig Gen Mohammad Mobarak Hossain Majumder, psc, Honorable Vice Chancellor, BAUST, Saidpur. The session was chaired by Assoc. Prof. Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-charge) and Head, Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur.
The keynote presentation was delivered by Prof. Tahmeed M. Al-Hussaini, Civil Engg. Dept., BUET, and President of the Bangladesh Earthquake Society. He discussed earthquake risks in Bangladesh, key provisions of BNBC-2020, and various disaster mitigation strategies in detail. He also highlighted major earthquake events in Nepal, Turkey, Syria, and Japan, emphasizing Bangladesh’s potential vulnerability and the importance of preparedness. He also emphasized that unplanned urbanization and poor construction practices significantly increase seismic risks in Bangladesh. He stressed the necessity of strictly following BNBC-2020, ensuring the use of quality construction materials, and developing skilled engineers to reduce earthquake-related risks and losses.
In his remarks, the chief guest stated that Bangladesh lies in a seismically vulnerable region and therefore greater awareness is essential at all levels. He highlighted that disaster impacts can be significantly reduced through modern technology, research, and sound engineering practices. He also appreciated the initiative of the Civil Engineering Department and encouraged students to gain more practical, field-oriented knowledge.
The Chairperson thanked the invited guests, faculty members, and students for their participation. He expressed hope that the discussions from the seminar would play an important role in enhancing the professional competence and awareness of future engineers.
The seminar was attended by the university Registrar, Treasurer, Controller of Examinations, along with faculty members and more than one hundred Civil Engineering students.
Later, a low-cost earthquake monitoring device, known as a “low-cost accelerometer,” was installed on campus as part of modern seismic observation technology being introduced in selected areas of the country.

content.rendered:
The Capstone Project Presentation of the Level-4 Term-1 students was held 19 May,2026 in the department of civil Engineering at BAUST,Saidpur.
Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean of the FCE and Head of the Department, attended the program as the Chief Guest and delivered an inspiring speech to motivate the students.
The event was coordinated by Md. Sohrab Mia, Lecturer. All respected faculty members were also present to encourage and appreciate the students’ innovative ideas and efforts.

title.rendered: 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, Saidpur Participates in 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 𝟭.𝟬 Organized by 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧 Authority

content.rendered:
With great enthusiasm and team spirit, the faculty members, officers, staff, and students of the 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫 actively participated in 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 𝟭.𝟬, arranged by the BAUST Sports Club.
The marathon was more than just a sporting event—it was a celebration of energy, determination, togetherness, and positive spirit. Participants from across the university joined the program with great enthusiasm, making the event vibrant and memorable for everyone involved.
Such activities play an important role in encouraging physical fitness, mental well-being, and stronger connections among members of the BAUST community while complementing academic life with valuable extracurricular experiences.
The Department of Civil Engineering is proud to have been part of this exciting initiative and eagerly awaits more events that inspire unity, wellness, and teamwork.

title.rendered: BAUST ,Civil Engineering Faculty Visit to Barapukuria Coal Mine for Practical Engineering Insights

content.rendered:
𝐁𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐮𝐤𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐚 𝐂𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐞, the only operating underground coal mine in Bangladesh, stands as one of the nation’s most significant energy resources and a remarkable example of large-scale underground engineering. To explore its practical relevance to Civil Engineering, infrastructure development, underground construction systems, and geotechnical engineering, a team of faculty members from the 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫 visited the mine on 13 May 2026.
The team was led by 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean (In-Charge), Faculty of Civil Engineering.
The visit offered an exceptional opportunity to gain firsthand experience of real-world engineering practices associated with underground excavation, ground stability, mine infrastructure, drainage and ventilation systems, transportation networks, and environmental management. Such industrial visits play a vital role in bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, while also enriching professional understanding of complex engineering operations.

The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur extends its sincere gratitude to 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐁𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐮𝐤𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐚 𝐂𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐞 for their warm hospitality, valuable guidance, and insightful technical discussions throughout the visit.

title.rendered: Digital Survey Field Session for CE Students

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur always encourages students to gain practical knowledge alongside academic learning.
Yesterday, students from the 21st and 22nd batches were taken to Shaheed Dr. Zikrul Haque Hall field to observe and participate in a Digital Surveying session. This hands-on experience helped them understand the practical application of surveying techniques in the field.

title.rendered: Successful Completion of AutoCAD Drawing Competition

content.rendered:
We are proud to announce the successful conclusion of the AutoCAD Drawing Competition, organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) at BAUST.
This achievement would not have been possible without the visionary leadership of our Club Advisor and the unwavering support of our Departmental Faculty. A special thank you goes to our dedicated Organizing Committee—your relentless hard work and coordination were the keys to this event’s success.
We also extend our sincere appreciation to all the participants for their enthusiasm and technical excellence.
With the continued support of our students and the department, we look forward to hosting even larger and more impactful events in the future. Onward and upward!
#CEIC #BAUST #CivilEngineering #AutoCAD #EngineeringExcellence #EventSuccess

title.rendered: Farewell & Orientation Program – Dept. of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur.

content.rendered:
Farewell & Orientation Program – Dept. of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur.
On 3 February 2026, the Department of Civil Engineering successfully organized a Farewell Program for the latest graduated students along with an Orientation Program for the newly admitted 22nd batch students. The program was organized by the students of the 15th batch.
The program was graced by Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department, as the Chief Guest.
All respected faculty members of the department were present, making the event more meaningful. The Chief Guest handed over crests and gifts to the students and delivered an inspiring and motivational speech at the end of the program, encouraging the students to pursue excellence in their academic and professional lives.
Heartfelt best wishes to our graduating students for a bright and successful futurea nd a warm welcome to the newly admitted 22nd batch, wishing them a rewarding academic journey ahead.

title.rendered: Strengthening Industry–Academia Collaboration

content.rendered:
On 28-01-2026, a group of faculty members from the Department of Civil Engineering, Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, paid a courtesy visit to three renowned government civil engineering organizations in Nilphamari:

  • Public Works Department (PWD)
  • Roads and Highways Department (RHD)
  • Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB)

The visit was organized to express sincere appreciation for their valuable support and contribution to the Industrial Attachment Program of Civil Engineering students.

The delegation was led by the Dean (In-Charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hassan, and coordinated by the Industrial Attachment Coordinator, Lecturer Ahasanul Haque Hashib.

As a token of appreciation, gift hampers were presented to the respective offices.

The meeting also explored future collaborative opportunities in consultancy and material testing services through the BAUST Consultancy and Testing Center (BCTC).

The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, looks forward to further strengthening this partnership.

title.rendered: Capstone Project Presentation 4-II Semester (Summer 2026) Successfully Held

content.rendered:
Capstone Project Presentation | Level-4, Term-2 | 21st January, 2026

The Department of Civil Engineering successfully organized the Capstone Project Presentation for Level-4, Term-2 students on 21 January 2026, marking an important academic milestone in their undergraduate journey. The program was chaired by Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean of the FCE and Head of the Department, whose visionary leadership and thoughtful guidance added significant value to the proceedings and the event was efficiently planned and smoothly conducted by Md. Sohrab Mia, Lecturer & Capstone Coordinator, whose dedication and careful coordination played a key role in the successful execution of the program. All esteemed faculty members were present and actively engaged throughout the session, offering constructive feedback, insightful questions, and valuable guidance to the students.

The students presented two projects:
1. Development of a Six-Story Residential Building for Bachelor
2. Design a Modular Business-Oriented Resort in Chowmuhoni, Saidpur

We warmly congratulate all the students on completing this significant academic requirement and commend their hard work, perseverance, and commitment. We wish them continued success in their future academic and professional endeavors.

We congratulate all the students on achieving this important academic milestone and wish them continued success in the future.

title.rendered: Industrial Attachment of Level-4 Term-I Successfully Completed for Summer 2026 Semester at Department of Civil Engineering at BAUST Saidpur

content.rendered:
𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐂𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐦 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐥-𝐋𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠

An official commencement of the two-week Industrial Attachment (Internship) Program for the Level-4, Term-I students of the 16th batch, Department of Civil Engineering, Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, on January 4, 2026.
As per the requirements of the Outcome-Based Education (OBE) system, the students have started their attachment to two prominent Bangladesh government organizations in Nilphamari:

  • 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 (𝐑𝐇𝐃)
  • 𝐏𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐜 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 (𝐏𝐖𝐃)

On the first day of the program, students were formally introduced to the Executive Engineers and Sub-Divisional Engineers of the respective departments. These introductory sessions provided students with valuable insights into professional engineering practices, including project planning, site supervision, safety management, and infrastructure development within the public sector. Students were accompanied by Lecturer Ahasanul Haque Hashib, the Industrial Attachment Coordinator for CE 4170, who is coordinating this program.

The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, remains dedicated to producing industry-ready graduates capable of contributing effectively to national infrastructure development.

𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐒𝐮𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝟏𝟗𝐭𝐡 & 𝟐𝟎𝐭𝐡 𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐝 𝐮𝐩 𝐭𝐨𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐳𝐳𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬-𝐨𝐧 𝐞𝐱𝐚𝐦𝐬 𝐚𝐭 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐂𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐅𝐢𝐞𝐥𝐝. 👷‍♂️📐
𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. Mahmudul Hasan, 𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, observed the exams and encouraged the students.
All 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐲 𝐦𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬 were present to support and guide the students throughout.

Heartfelt thanks to 𝐇𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐛𝐮𝐫 𝐑𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐚𝐧, 𝐋𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐫, 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐭. 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐄, all faculty, and our dedicated students for making the Practical Surveying session a success.

title.rendered: 6th Founding Aniversary of Department of Civil Engineering at BAUST Saidpur

content.rendered:
𝗖𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗯𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝟲 𝗬𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗘𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 | 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿.

On 𝟭𝟱 𝗗𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱 , the Department of Civil Engineering, Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, proudly celebrated its 𝟲𝘁𝗵 𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗮𝗿𝘆 with a cake-cutting ceremony.

The occasion was graced by the honorable presence of 𝘽𝙧𝙞𝙜 𝙂𝙚𝙣 𝙈𝙤𝙝𝙖𝙢𝙢𝙖𝙙 𝙈𝙤𝙗𝙖𝙧𝙖𝙠 𝙃𝙤𝙨𝙨𝙖𝙞𝙣 𝙈𝙖𝙟𝙪𝙢𝙙𝙚𝙧, 𝙥𝙨𝙘, 𝙑𝙞𝙘𝙚 𝘾𝙝𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚𝙡𝙡𝙤𝙧; 𝙇𝙩 𝘾𝙤𝙡 𝙈𝙙 𝙎𝙝𝙖𝙢𝙚𝙚𝙢 𝙍𝙚𝙯𝙖, 𝙋𝙝𝘿 (𝙍𝙚𝙩𝙙), 𝙏𝙧𝙚𝙖𝙨𝙪𝙧𝙚𝙧; 𝘾𝙤𝙡 𝘾𝙝𝙤𝙬𝙙𝙝𝙪𝙧𝙮 𝙎𝙖𝙞𝙛 𝙐𝙙𝙙𝙞𝙣 𝙆𝙖𝙬𝙨𝙖𝙧, 𝙋𝘽𝙂𝙈, 𝙎𝙞𝙜𝙨 (𝙇𝙋𝙍), 𝙍𝙚𝙜𝙞𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙖𝙧; 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙇𝙩 𝘾𝙤𝙡 𝙎𝙮𝙚𝙙 𝙎𝙖𝙡𝙖𝙝𝙪𝙙𝙙𝙞𝙣 𝙉𝙖𝙮𝙖𝙣, 𝙎𝙐𝙋, 𝘽𝙂𝘽𝙈, 𝘽𝙂𝙊𝙈, 𝙥𝙨𝙘, 𝙄𝙣𝙛, 𝘾𝙤𝙣𝙩𝙧𝙤𝙡𝙡𝙚𝙧 𝙤𝙛 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙀𝙭𝙖𝙢𝙞𝙣𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨. 𝗔𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗻𝘀, including Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, 𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, were also present. Faculty members of the Department of Civil Engineering actively participated in the celebration. The program concluded with an interactive discussion session, followed by light snacks, fostering collegial interaction and reinforcing the department’s shared vision for academic excellence and future growth.

title.rendered: Farewell of Md. Faysal Kabir, Lecturer, Dept. of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur

content.rendered:
Today, the farewell program of Md. Faysal Kabir, Lecturer, Dept. of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, was held with due respect and warmth.

The program was honored by the presence of the Dean (In-charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department, Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, along with all faculty members, who extended their heartfelt wishes to him.

On behalf of the Dept. of CE, the Dean of the FCE presented a commemorative crest to Md. Faysal Kabir as a token of appreciation.
As a dedicated faculty member, Md. Faysal Kabir, sir, made significant contributions to the Dept. of Civil Engg._BAUST, Bangladesh, which will always be remembered.
We extend our sincere congratulations and best wishes for his new journey, wishing him continued success and fulfillment in all future endeavors.
Best wishes, Md. Faysal Kabir Sir.

title.rendered: Thesis Predefense Successfully Held for Summer 2026 Semester

content.rendered:
A Thesis Pre-Defense program for the Level-4, Term-1 students of the Department of Civil Engineering was held today.
The session was chaired by Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department. The program was coordinated by Habibur Rahman, Lecturer, and Faisal Ahmed, Lecturer. All faculty members were present and contributed to the evaluation process. At the end of the session, the Chairman delivered valuable guidance and directives to the students to help them strengthen their upcoming thesis work.

content.rendered: A board viva for the 3rd and 4th year students was held today at the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur. Two separate boards were arranged for the assessment. Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department, served as the Chairman of one board, while Kh. Shihab Uddin Ahmed, Lecturer, chaired the other. All faculty members were present and actively participated in the evaluation process. The session was conducted smoothly and provided a valuable opportunity for students to demonstrate their academic progress and preparedness.

title.rendered: Capstone Presentation of Level-4 Term-I Students of Summer 2026 Semester

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering successfully organized the Capstone Presentation for Level-4, Term-I students on 19 November 2025. We were honored to have Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean of the Faculty of CE and Head of the Department, as the Chief Guest. The program was coordinated by Anzuman Ara Priya, Lecturer, dept. of Civil Engineering. Students presented their innovative projects with confidence and professionalism. All faculty members, along with students from Level-3, were present and actively engaged throughout the session.
At the end of the program, the Chief Guest delivered a guiding and inspiring speech, motivating students to pursue excellence in their academic and professional journeys.

title.rendered: Ahasanul H. Hashib, Lecturer CE, has been selected as a Preparation Committee Member for the Honda Young Engineers & Scientists (Y-E-S) Forum 2026

content.rendered:
Alhamdulillah, heartfelt congratulations to Ahasanul H. Hashib, Lecturer, Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, for being selected as a Preparation Committee Member for the Honda Young Engineers & Scientists (Y-E-S) Forum 2026)!

He recently attended the prestigious Y-E-S Forum in Japan and has now returned to us with enriching experiences and valuable insights to share. The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, takes great pride in his achievement and wishes him continued success ahead.

title.rendered: Seminar on Metro Rail Construction in Dhaka City: Challenges and Opportunities

content.rendered:
After the recent Dhaka Metro Rail accident that stirred nationwide discussion on construction safety, the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur arranged a timely seminar titled “Metro Rail Construction in Dhaka City: Challenges and Opportunities.”

Honourable VC Brig Gen Mohammad Mobarak Hossain Majumder, psc graced the event with his inspiring speech and presented the crest to the keynote speaker Md. Sohel Rana (Deputy Project Director, MRT Line-5, South; GM, Planning, DMTCL), who delivered an insightful presentation and interacted with students through Q&A.

Sincere appreciation to Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan (Dean In-Charge, FCE; Head, Dept. of CE) for his valuable speech and kind presence.
Gratitude to Sabiha Tasnim Rifa, Lecturer (CE), for coordinating the event successfully, and to the 15th batch students for their dedicated effort in organizing the program. All faculty members and students of the Department of Civil Engineering were present and actively participated in the seminar.

title.rendered: Departmental Picnic 2026 of Civil Engineering Department

content.rendered:
The Civil Engineering Department Picnic 2025 has been successfully completed!

We started our journey from the BAUST Campus at 7 AM with great excitement and enthusiasm. Our first destination was Mini Mina Bazar, Tetulia, Panchagarh, where we arrived around 10 AM. Along with the site visit, faculty members and students enjoyed a joyful photo session together. We explored the resort, learned about tea cultivation, and spent a wonderful time together.

After visiting Kazi & Kazi Tea Estate, our next destination was Meghkunjo, where we enjoyed a delightful lunch together in a cheerful and refreshing environment. We were deeply honored by the presence of our respected guests — Honorable Vice Chancellor Brig Gen Mohammad Mobarak Hossain Majumder, psc, Treasurer Lt Col Md Shameem Reza, PhD (Retd), and Controller of Examinations Lt Col Syed Salahuddin Nayan, BGOM, psc, Inf — who joined us there and shared wonderful moments with faculty members and students.

A tree plantation program was also organized at Meghkunjo by the Environment and Sustainability Club – ESC, BAUST, adding a meaningful touch to the day’s celebration. It was truly a heartwarming and memorable part of our picnic!

title.rendered: Collaborating for Empowering Youth: BAUST Faculty and Student Join Futurenation’s Skill Development Workshop

content.rendered:
On Thursday, September 18, 2025, two of our faculty members (Faisal Ahmed from the Civil Engineering (CE) Department and Rezaul Karim from the Accounting and Information Systems (AIS) Department) and a fourth-year student participated in the Regional Skilled Hub Workshop in Rangpur. Hosted by Futurenation, a subsidiary of United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and sponsored by the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority (BIDA) and Grameenphone, the event focused on empowering the nation’s youth through free skill-development programs.

Our faculty members, Faisal Ahmed from the Civil Engineering (CE) Department and Rezaul Karim from the Accounting and Information Systems (AIS) Department, joined a fourth-year student to represent our institution. They engaged with fellow faculty and students from across the Rangpur division to discuss how to improve and expand these vital training initiatives.

Futurenation’s mission is to provide free training in key areas such as freelancing, graphic design, and English speaking, alongside workshops aimed at building leadership and teamwork abilities. The workshop provided an excellent platform for participants to share insights on overcoming challenges and making these programs more accessible nationwide.

This event was also a fantastic networking opportunity, allowing our representatives to connect with peers from various institutions and contribute to a larger conversation about shaping a more skilled and prepared workforce for Bangladesh’s future. We’re proud to have been a part of this important discussion.

title.rendered: Industrial Attachment for Summer 2025 Semester Successfully Organized by Dept. of Civil Engineering

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST successfully organized the Industrial Attachment (CE 4170) Presentation for Level 4 Term 1 students today.

We were delighted to have Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan , Dean (In-Charge), FCE and Associate Professor & Head of CE Dept., as the Chief Guest, and Md. Faysal Kabir, Lecturer and Course Coordinator (CE 4170), as the Chairperson. All faculty members joined the program, making it a meaningful and successful event. The Chief Guest and the Chairperson also shared inspiring and motivational words with the students, which made the session even more valuable.

We sincerely thank the Chief Guest for his valuable time and the Chairperson for arranging this wonderful program.

title.rendered: Thesis Defense 2025 – BAUST Civil Engineering

content.rendered:
Thesis Defense 2025 – BAUST Civil Engineering

The final year students of the Department of Civil Engineering successfully showcased their research and defended their thesis on 30 July 2025. The event was attended by all faculty members, highlighting the culmination of years of dedication and hard work. The program was graced by Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-Charge), FCE, and Associate Professor & Head of the Department, as the Chief Guest. He delivered an insightful and inspiring speech, encouraging students to excel in their future engineering endeavors.  Congratulations to all the students for reaching this significant academic milestone!

content.rendered:
CE 4000 Thesis: Pre-defense Presentation

A remarkable day filled with academic excellence, innovation, and inspiration! Our Level-4, Term-1 students showcased their thesis work (pre-defence) with confidence and dedication.

Date: June 03, 2025

Venue: Seminar Hall, Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST

Heartfelt thanks to our Chief Guest, Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-Charge), FCE, and Head of the Department, and our Thesis Coordinator, Habibur Rahman Habib, Lecturer, for their continuous guidance and support.
The event concluded with a powerful motivational and educative speech by the Chief Guest, leaving students inspired to strive further in their academic and professional journey.

title.rendered: Presentation on Capstone Project of Winter 2025 Semester Successfully Held at Dept of Civil Engineering

content.rendered:
Presentation on Capstone Project

📌 Topic: Execution Strategies of Project in Professional Life
🗓️ Date: May 28, 2025
🕙 Time: 10:50 AM – 12:30 PM
👨‍🏫 Chief Guest: Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Civil Engineering
🧑‍🏫 Course Coordinator: Md. Sohrab Mia

An engaging and insightful session was successfully organized by the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, aimed at bridging the gap between theoretical academic knowledge and practical project execution in the professional world. 💼🔧
Our honorable Chief Guest, Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, delivered a thought-provoking speech filled with real-world examples and professional wisdom. His words helped students understand the importance of strategic planning, on-site decision-making, and adaptability when executing projects in real-life scenarios.

The entire Capstone Project journey was smoothly and effectively guided by our Course Coordinator, Md. Sohrab Mia, whose mentorship ensured that each phase — from concept development to final execution — was handled with professionalism and attention to detail. His continuous support and insightful feedback were instrumental in building students’ confidence and enhancing their project management and teamwork abilities.

📋 The Capstone coordination and supervision were further strengthened by the valuable contributions of Md. Jahangir Alam, Habibur Rahman, and Md. Fazzle Rabby. Their expert guidance, timely suggestions, and technical insights significantly enriched the overall project experience, empowering students to think critically and solve real-world challenges effectively.
Moreover, several respected faculty members were present during the session and shared their valuable feedback and suggestions. Their constructive opinions and encouragement inspired students to reflect on their performance and provided practical advice on how to improve their skills and approach for future endeavors.

🔖 #BAUST #CivilEngineering #CapstonePresentation #ProfessionalSkill

content.rendered:
TENSILE TRAILS 1.0 – A Competition to Build Sustainable Concrete

Organized by BAUST CEIC Club

Venue: Dept. of Civil Engineering at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur
The wait is over! The grand finale of Tensile Trails 1.0 – our signature tensile strength competition – was held successfully today showcasing innovation, precision, and engineering brilliance!
From intense testing to triumphant wins, the event was a true celebration of civil engineering spirit.
Congratulations to all the participants and the winners who stood out with their concrete strength and creativity!

Here’s to building stronger ideas and even stronger structures.

Stay tuned for more exciting initiatives from CEIC Club!

title.rendered: Presentation on Industrial Attachment for Winter 2025 Semester successfully organised by CE Dept. at BAUST

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, successfully organized a presentation program titled “From the Classroom to the Real World Engineering Field: A Journey Through Industrial Attachment” at Dr. Wazed Mia Seminar Hall. Level-4, Term-1 students shared their valuable experiences gained during the industrial attachment, reflecting their transition from academic learning to real-life engineering practices.

The Chief Guest of the event was Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-charge) of the faculty of Civil Engineering and Associate Professor & Head of the department of Civil Engg., BAUST. Special thanks to Md. Faysal Kabir, Lecturer, Department of Civil Engineering and Coordinator of the Industrial Attachment Program, for his sincere efforts in making the event a grand success.

The program concluded with a motivational speech by the Head of the Department, followed by a vibrant photo session with students and faculty members.

title.rendered: CE Faculty Members Receive Vice Chancellor’s Excellence Award

content.rendered:
Celebrating Excellence at BAUST!

On March 24th, the Vice Chancellor’s Excellence Awards 2024 took place at BAUST, recognizing outstanding contributions in research, teaching, and service. Such initiatives are truly inspiring and motivate everyone to strive for excellence.
A heartfelt congratulations to our esteemed faculty members from the Department of Civil Engineering:
🔴 Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-Charge) of the faculty of Civil Engineering, Associate Professor and Head of the department, for receiving the Vice Chancellor’s Teaching Excellence Award 2024 and VC’s Research Excellence Award 2024
🔴 Md. Fazle Rabby, Lecturer, for receiving the VC’s Research Incentive Award for publishing in indexed journals.
🔴 Sabiha Tasnim Rifa, Lecturer, for receiving the Vice Chancellor’s Teaching Excellence Award 2024.

Your achievements serve as a great source of inspiration for everyone! A big thank you to the organizers for arranging such a prestigious event to honor academic excellence.

title.rendered: Iftar Mahfil organised by the CE Department at BAUST

content.rendered:
On March 16, 2025, the Civil Engineering Department of BAUST successfully organized a wonderful Iftar Mahfil. The event was graced by the presence of our esteemed Vice Chancellor, Brig Gen A B M Humayun Kabir, SGP, ndc, psc, along with the Registrar, Treasurer, Controller of Examinations, and several other distinguished guests. Their presence made the occasion even more special.

A huge appreciation goes to the coordinators for their outstanding efforts in organizing this event so beautifully—especially Md. Faysal Kabir sir, Md. Jahangir Alam Sir, and Sabiha Tasnim Rifa ma’am. A sincere thank you to all the students who worked together with dedication and enthusiasm to make this event a grand success. Your teamwork and commitment made this gathering truly meaningful and memorable!

title.rendered: CE Department Graduate Pursuing MBA at University of Wales, Trinity David, London

content.rendered:
A Moment of Pride and Celebration!

It is with great joy and pride that we celebrate the incredible achievement of Sheikh Khosruzzaman, a graduate of the Civil Engineering Department, Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur (class of 2023)! From excelling in Civil Engineering at BAUST to embarking on a new journey of academic excellence by pursuing an MBA at the University of Wales Trinity Saint David, London, this accomplishment is truly inspiring.
Your dedication, perseverance, and ambition have paved the way for this remarkable success. This new chapter is not just a personal milestone but also a moment of pride for all of us who have witnessed your journey.
We have no doubt that you will continue to shine and achieve even greater heights in your academic and professional career. Wishing you the very best in this exciting new phase—may you make the most of every opportunity and create a future filled with success and fulfillment!

Congratulations once again! The entire BAUST family is proud of you!

Celebrating Dedication & Excellence! 

Students with 100% attendance in all courses from the last term were honored with certificates and prizes in the Civil Engineering Department, BAUST.

Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-Charge) & Head of CE Dept., and Lt Col Md Shameem Reza, PhD (Retd), Treasurer, handed over the awards to recognize their commitment.

Congratulations to all the awardees! Keep up the great work!

title.rendered: Seminar on “Advanced Transportation Technologies in Japan: A Vision for Bangladesh’s Future” successfully organized by Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST

content.rendered:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST successfully organized an insightful seminar on “Advanced Transportation Technologies in Japan: A Vision for Bangladesh’s Future” today at Dr. Wazed Mia Seminar Hall.

The event was a remarkable success, with active participation from students who showed great enthusiasm and engagement throughout the session. The keynote speaker, Ahasanul Haque Hashib, shared fascinating insights and personal experiences from his journey to Japan. His reflections on Japan’s advanced transportation technologies and their potential application in Bangladesh truly inspired and motivated the students.

The seminar was coordinated by Sabiha Tasnim Rifa, Lecturer, Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, whose dedication and efforts ensured the smooth execution of the event. We were also privileged to have Lt Col Md Shameem Reza, PhD (Retd), Treasurer, BAUST, with us. We sincerely thank him for making time to be part of this seminar and for his encouraging words. Additionally, Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In Charge), FCE, and Head of the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, chaired the seminar and provided insightful remarks, enriching the discussion further.

The seminar successfully provided a platform for students to learn, engage, and envision how advanced transportation technologies can shape the future of Bangladesh.

title.rendered: Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan has successfully completed the prestigious Teaching Excellence Program (TEP)

content.rendered:
Proud Achievement for the Civil Engineering Department!

We are thrilled to share that our respected Head of the Department, Dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, and Associate Professor, Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, has successfully completed the prestigious Teaching Excellence Program (TEP) organized by the Quality Assurance Section of UGC. He attended the training as the Additional Director of IQAC, BAUST.
This significant achievement reflects his commitment to advancing teaching standards and academic excellence. The insights and knowledge gained from this esteemed program will undoubtedly benefit our Civil Engineering Department and enrich the academic environment at BAUST.

We look forward to seeing the positive impact of his experience as we continue striving for academic growth, innovation, and excellence together!

title.rendered: Celebrating Success at BAUST Pitha Utsob 2025

content.rendered:
Celebrating Success at BAUST Pitha Utsob 2025

We are delighted to share that the Civil Engineering Department’s stall, “Pitha Mohol”, secured 2nd place at the Pitha Utsob 2025 held on February 17 at BAUST!

This achievement would not have been possible without the dedication of our students, faculty members, and volunteers, who worked tirelessly to make our stall a success. From beautiful decorations to delicious pithas, every effort was truly commendable.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Brig Gen A B M Humayun Kabir, SGP, ndc, psc, te, Honorable Vice Chancellor of BAUST, for his continuous encouragement and support.

A special thanks to Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-Charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering & Head of the Department of Civil Engineering, for his guidance and inspiration. We also sincerely thank Md. Faysal Kabir (Lecturer, CE), Coordinator of the Pitha Utsob of the CE Department, for his incredible efforts in organizing and leading this wonderful event.

A huge thank you to everyone who participated and cheered for us! This event was a celebration of teamwork, tradition, and togetherness. Let’s continue to create wonderful memories and strive for greater achievements!

content.rendered:
Happy 10th Birthday, BAUST 


Today, we celebrate a decade of growth, excellence, and dedication at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST). As part of this incredible institution, the Civil Engineering Department is proud to contribute to shaping the future of civil engineering education.

Over the past 10 years, BAUST has not only been a place of learning but a family that inspires, challenges, and empowers its students.

Here’s to many more years of success, innovation, and endless opportunities! Happy Birthday, BAUST!

title.rendered: Dr. Md Mahmudul Hasan Addresses ‘Polythene Bag Pollution and Our Environment’ at “Tarunner Uthshab 2025” Closing Ceremony

content.rendered:
Dr. Md Mahmudul Hasan Addresses ‘Polythene Bag Pollution and Our Environment’ at “Tarunner Uthshab 2025” Closing Ceremony:
Our esteemed Dean (In charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Associate Professor Dr. Md Mahmudul Hasan, delivered an inspiring and thought-provoking lecture at the closing ceremony of Tarunner Uthshab 2025, a month-long event organized by the BAIUST Civil Engineering Club, BAIUST, Cumilla.

As the guest of honor and keynote speaker, Dr. Mahmud captivated the audience with his powerful 45-minute speech on the pressing issue of “Polythene Bag Pollution and Our Environment.”

Dr. Mahmud discussed the severe consequences of polythene bag pollution, emphasizing its detrimental impact on soil health, water bodies, marine ecosystems, and public health. He elaborated on how non-biodegradable polythene bags clog drainage systems, increase flood risk, contaminate food chains, and contribute significantly to climate change. Additionally, he outlined practical steps to combat these challenges, including initiatives the Bangladesh government took to reduce plastic pollution.

A Bold Initiative: Making BAIUST a Polythene-Free Campus:
During his speech, Dr. Mahmud encouraged students to transform BAIUST into the first polythene bag-free university campus in Bangladesh by July 3, 2025, in alignment with International Plastic Bag Free Day. He emphasized that achieving this goal would be a landmark achievement in Bangladesh’s environmental movement, setting an example for other institutions to follow.

Dr. Mahmud expressed his gratitude to the Department of Civil Engineering, BAIUST, for selecting him for this prestigious program and acknowledged their efforts to raise environmental sustainability awareness.

The event concluded with a strong commitment from students and faculty to support this initiative and work towards a greener future.

title.rendered: Practical Surveying Successfully Completed by Civil Engineering Students at BAUST

content.rendered:
Practical Surveying Successfully Completed by Civil Engineering Students at BAUST

Practical surveying, a cornerstone and mandatory course in the Civil Engineering program, was successfully completed by the 17th and 18th batches of the Civil Engineering Department at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur. The seven-day fieldwork spanned from 12th to 20th January, 2025.

This meticulously organized field activity aimed to provide students with hands-on experience in surveying techniques. The program was conducted under the leadership of Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-Charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department, and was expertly coordinated by Habibur Rahman, Lecturer in the Department of Civil Engineering.

Guided by the unwavering support and expertise of faculty members, the students were able to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world application. In addition, the fieldwork fostered teamwork, communication and practical problem-solving skills of the students. The department of CE at BAUST, Saidpur, always prioritizes hands-on learning to prepare students for their future professional careers in civil engineering arena.

title.rendered: Prize Giving Ceremony of Reuse of Plastic Materials Competition organised by ESC Club

content.rendered:
On November 11, the Environment and Sustainability Club, ESC, BAUST organized the Reuse of Plastic Materials Competition. The event saw an impressive 18 teams participating, each showcasing their creativity and innovation by turning plastic waste into beautiful, functional projects.

Today, the much-anticipated results were announced, and the winning teams were honored with prizes. The awards were graciously distributed by Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department.

A big congratulations to all the participants for their hard work and dedication towards promoting sustainability and environmental awareness through their brilliant projects! 🌍♻️

#Sustainability #PlasticReuse #EnvironmentalAwareness #BAUST #CivilEngineering,BAUST #Innovation #GreenFuture

title.rendered: Undergraduate Thesis Pre-defense for Summer 2024 Semester

content.rendered:
🌟 Proud Moment for the Department of Civil Engineering! 🌟

We are thrilled to announce the successful conduct of the undergraduate thesis pre-defense for our talented civil engineering students. This marks a crucial step in their academic journey as they presented their research, showcased innovative ideas, and received valuable insights from our esteemed faculties.

The dedication, hard work, and technical expertise displayed by our students were truly commendable. Their efforts reflect the spirit of excellence that defines our department.

A heartfelt thank you to our supervisors, externals and faculties for their guidance and support throughout this process. We look forward to the final thesis defenses and are excited about the contributions our students will make to the field of civil engineering.

Here’s to building a stronger future, one step at a time! 🏗️🌍

#CivilEngineering #ThesisPreDefense #AcademicExcellence #ProudMoment

This distinguished recognition reflects the visionary leadership and relentless commitment to excellence of the honourable VC. We are privileged to work under his guidance and celebrate this well-deserved achievement with great admiration.

title.rendered: Celebrating Innovation and Sustainability: Highlights from the Reuse of Plastic Materials Competition

content.rendered:
A huge round of applause to the 18 teams who enthusiastically participated in the Reuse of Plastic Materials Competition, organized by the Environment and Sustainability Club! Each team impressed the audience with their outstanding creativity and innovative projects, all designed to address plastic waste and promote sustainability in impactful ways.

The competition was honored by the presence of our Vice Chancellor (Acting), Treasurer, Registrar, esteemed Heads of various departments, and other distinguished guests. A special note of gratitude goes to the dedicated faculty members from the Department of Civil Engineering, who lent their expertise as judges, ensuring a high standard of evaluation.

We extend heartfelt thanks to Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean-in-Charge and Head of the Civil Engineering Department, and Club Advisor, Habibur Rahman, for their unwavering support and guidance in making this event a resounding success.

This competition was more than just an exhibition; it was a testament to our students’ talent, passion, and commitment to environmental stewardship. By bringing innovative ideas to life, they have shown that sustainable practices are achievable and necessary for the future.

Let’s continue to inspire and work collectively towards a cleaner, greener planet!

title.rendered: Civil Engineering Students from BAUST Complete Industrial Attachment at SOLEX Engineers, Rangpur

content.rendered:
Our enthusiastic Level-4 Term-I Civil Engineering students from the Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST) have successfully concluded their industrial attachment with SOLEX Engineers in Rangpur. This immersive experience has been pivotal in bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, allowing students to witness firsthand the complexities and demands of the engineering industry.

Throughout their attachment, the students gained vital insights and developed a range of skills, enhancing their understanding of field operations and project management. Last week, they presented a detailed overview of their training, highlighting the lessons learned, practical problem-solving strategies, and tips to help future students make the most of similar opportunities. Their journey was also chronicled in a comprehensive report, which stands as a testament to their dedication and growth.

We take immense pride in these students for their hard work and commitment. Their achievements exemplify the potential of BAUST’s Civil Engineering department, nurturing future leaders who are set to contribute significantly to the engineering landscape.

title.rendered: Congratulations to Ahasanul H. Hashib sir for being Accepted as Short Term Visiting Researcher in the Traffic Engineering Group at University of Tokyo, Japan

content.rendered:
🌟Congratulations to Ahasanul H. Hashib🌟

We are thrilled to announce that Ahasanul H. Hashib, a dedicated faculty member of our Civil Engineering Department, has been selected as a short-term (3 months) visiting researcher at the University of Tokyo, Japan! This incredible opportunity is fully funded by the Honda Foundation under the Honda Young Engineer and Scientist (YES) Award Plus Program.

Alhamdulillah, he already arrived in Japan. The dept. wishes that he will embark on this exciting journey of knowledge exchange and research collaboration. The dept also expects that the students of CE dept, BAUST will be benefited after his return. 👏🌏

title.rendered: Heartfelt congratulations to Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan Sir on his appointment as the Dean (In-Charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, BAUST!

content.rendered:
Heartfelt congratulations to Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan Sir on his appointment as the Dean (In-Charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, BAUST! 🎉

Dr. Hasan is currently serving as an Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Civil Engineering at BAUST. Alongside his teaching and administrative duties, he is also contributing as the Additional Director of the IQAC at BAUST.

Dr. Mahmud has been working and doing research in the environmental sector for over 20 years. With a diverse research focus on Water and various Environmental Engineering aspects, Dr. Hasan has significantly impacted both academia and industry. Currently, he has 27 publications in several reputed journals and international conference proceedings. He is a fellow of IEB and also active with BAETE in relation to the OBE system.

We, the Civil Engineering family of BAUST, are delighted to celebrate his new milestone! Wishing him all the best for continued success. 👏

title.rendered: Popsicle Truss Bridge Competition organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC)

content.rendered:
The Civil Engineering Department at BAUST made history by hosting its inaugural Truss Bridge Competition on September 21, 2024. Organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC), the event was a platform for students to showcase their engineering prowess. A total of 13 enthusiastic teams participated, each bringing their uniquely designed truss bridge to the competition. The atmosphere was filled with excitement as students combined creativity with technical knowledge to construct bridges capable of bearing impressive loads. Held at 3:30 PM, the event demonstrated the practical application of theoretical concepts learned in the classroom.

The teams were judged on various criteria, including the efficiency and durability of their bridges under stress. As the competition progressed, the increasing load tests pushed the boundaries of what these young engineers had envisioned. This hands-on experience not only tested their structural understanding but also emphasized teamwork, problem-solving, and time management. Each team’s effort was a clear reflection of their dedication and preparation leading up to the competition.

Faculty members, including advisors from the CEIC, played an instrumental role in guiding the students throughout the process. The event also attracted spectators from across the university, eager to witness the creative engineering solutions on display. The participants took pride in their work, knowing that this competition was a stepping stone to future professional challenges.

The truss bridge competition at BAUST symbolizes the university’s commitment to practical learning and innovation in engineering. It also highlighted the importance of extracurricular activities that enhance technical skills. For many, the event was not only a competition but a learning experience that will inspire them in their future careers. This remarkable initiative by the CEIC is set to become a tradition in the years to come.

Some Beautiful Captures from the Event

title.rendered: Tree Plantation Event Organised by the Environment and Sustainability Club of the Department of Civil Engineering at BAUST Saidpur

content.rendered:
18 September 2024, the Environment and Sustainability Club proudly organized a vibrant tree plantation program that brought together our community in a shared commitment to a greener future! 💚

Our day began with an inspiring introduction highlighting the critical role trees play in our ecosystem—from improving air quality to providing habitats for wildlife. Volunteers of all ages joined us, equipped with shovels and a passion for the planet. Together, we planted a variety of native trees, ensuring our efforts support local biodiversity and resilience against climate change. 🌱

In addition to the planting, we hosted workshops that educated participants on the importance of trees, proper planting techniques, and how to care for our new leafy friends 📚✨

To sustain our efforts, we also shared tips on ongoing maintenance and the vital role everyone can play in nurturing these young trees. By the end of the day, we had not only added numerous trees to our local landscape but also fostered a sense of community and shared responsibility for our environment.

A huge thank you to all volunteers, participants, and supporters who made this event a success! Let’s continue to work together for a sustainable future, one tree at a time! 🌲❤️

title.rendered: The final Thesis Defense Presentation of 11th Batch- Dept. of CE, BAUST

content.rendered:
The final defense presentation on CE 4200: Project & Thesis

The final defense was successfully conducted today at the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST for the Winter 2024 semester. The students of 11th batch (CE- 2nd Batch) presented their thesis in front of the board of internal and external supervisor’s for fulfilling the requirement of the B.Sc degree.
Their thesis covered various aspects of Civil Engineering from Structural, Environmental and Transportation engineering sector.
They incorporated the local technical/engineering issues of north bengal and proposed feasible solution for them.
We believe that, their unique findings will help the scientific community as well as the local policy makers of north bengal to implement the fiscal measures.
The honorable head of the department Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan sir was present as the Chairman of the defense board and K.h Shihab Uddin Ahmed Sir as the thesis coordinator was also present along with other faculty members and stuff.
We believe that, our future students of Civil Engineering Department will also create meaningful research for the community using our state-of-the-art laboratory facilities at BAUST.
