title.rendered: Farewell to Our Beloved Teacher, Asst. Prof. Md. Izharul Haque Azad Sir

content.rendered:
Farewell to Our Beloved Teacher, Md. Izharul Haque Azad Sir
With heavy hearts, we bid farewell to our esteemed faculty member, Md. Izharul Haque Azad Sir. Today marks the end of an era as we say goodbye to a teacher who has been an integral part of the BAUST Civil Engineering Department for more than 4 years!
From the very beginning of our journey from December 15, 2019, Izhar Sir stood as one of its foundational pillars. His dedication and commitment over the past four years have been unparalleled. As one of the very first faculty members, he played a vital role in shaping our department’s identity and guiding its growth.
Throughout his tenure, Izhar Sir tirelessly conducted classes, mentored students, and provided invaluable advice to our clubs and initiatives. His passion for teaching, researching and his genuine concern for the development of his students have touched our hearts deeply.
In the words of our honorable Head of Department, Associate Professor Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, “Izhar was a true example of dedication in every aspect of his responsibilities. His absence will be deeply felt, as he was truly irreplaceable. He was also perfect in every aspect of his initiative, that’s why the word ‘PERFECT’ perfectly goes with him.”
On behalf of the entire BAUST Civil Engineering Department, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to you, Izhar Sir, for your tireless dedication and exceptional service. You have been more than just a teacher – you have been a mentor, a role model, and a great colleague.
We wish you all the best in your future endeavors and we are confident that you will continue to inspire and make a positive impact wherever you go.
Thank you, Izhar Sir, for everything. You will be dearly missed.
With warm regards,
Department of Civil Engineering
BAUST.

title.rendered: Prize giving ceremony of “Intra Dept. Drawing and CAD Contest” organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC)

content.rendered:
Prize giving ceremony of “Intra Dept. Drawing and CAD Contest” was organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) of our department few weeks back.

Three groups of students were awarded as Champion, First Runners up & Second Dinner up respectively. A crest and a certificate were awarded to them as an appreciating element.

All other participants also got a participation certificate from the club as well. Honourable Head of the department Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan Sir gave away the prizes and delivered a concluding speech to them. The club advisor Md. Izharul Haque Azad Sir was present there along with other faculty members. Ahsanul Haque Hashib Sir conducted the whole session for us.

title.rendered: ❤️🧡 পিঠা উৎসব ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উদযাপন – ২০২৪ 🧡❤️

content.rendered:
১৫-ই ফেব্রুয়ারি ২০২৪, বৃহস্পতিবার বিএইউএসটি এর সেন্ট্রাল ফিল্ডে বিশবিদ্যালয় দিবস পালন উপলক্ষ্যে আয়োজন করা হয়েছিল পিঠা উৎসব অনুষ্ঠান…

পুরকৌশল বিভাগের শিক্ষার্থীরা নিজ স্টল “পিঠা মহল” কে সাজিয়েছিল অপরূপ সাজে; সাজ সজ্জায় ছিলো পুরকৌশল বিভাগের ছোঁয়া, বিশেষত পদ্মা সেতুর একটি স্প্যান এর আদলে বানানো পিঠা রাখার টেবিল ছিল অন্যতম আকর্ষণ
সেই সাথে স্টলে ছিল হরেক রকম পিঠার বাহার
মাননীয় ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর ব্রি. জে. সানোয়ার উদ্দিন স্যার এবং প্রাক্তন ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর ব্রি. জে. মো: লুৎফর রহমান স্যার এর উপস্থিতিতে উদ্বোধন করা হয় আমাদের “পিঠা মহল” এর। অন্যান্য দপ্তর প্রধান, ডিন মহোদয় ও বিভাগীয় প্রধানগণের সাথে হরেক রকম পিঠার স্বাদ গ্রহণ করেন ভিসি স্যার এবং অতিথিবৃন্দ
পুরকৌশল বিভাগের আতিথেয়তায়ও মুগ্ধ হন তারা
পিঠা পরিবেশন, আপ্যায়ন, সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠান, গল্প-গুজব আর আড্ডায় জাকজমোকপূর্ণভাবে অতিবাহিত হয় পুরো সন্ধ্যা, সেই সাথে আয়োজন করা হয় সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠানের
দিনশেষে প্রত্যেক বিভাগের পিঠা উৎসব এর আয়োজন, উদযাপন ও আপ্যায়নসহ নানাবিধ বিষয় বিবেচনায় রেখে কর্তৃপক্ষের সিদ্ধান্ত মতে পুরকৌশল বিভাগের “পিঠা মহল” এবং সিএসই বিভাগের “বসন্তবৌরী” কে যৌথভাবে “বেস্ট স্টল” এর স্বীকৃতি দেওয়া হয়
উল্লেখ্য যে, গত ২০২৩ সালের পিঠা উৎসব অনুষ্ঠানেও পুরকৌশল বিভাগ ইংলিশ বিভাগের সাথে যৌথভাবে প্রথম হয়েছিল
এইবারও সেই ধারাবাহিকতা বজায় রেখেছে আমাদের ডিপার্টমেন্ট এর শিক্ষার্থীরা
এই স্বীকৃতির নেপথ্যে ছিলো পুরকৌশল বিভাগের শিক্ষার্থীদের অক্লান্ত পরিশ্রম, ডেডিকেশন, ক্রিয়েটিভ চিন্তাধারা এবং সম্মানিত বিভাগীয় প্রধান স্যার এর দিকনির্দেশনা

পুরকৌশল বিভাগের পক্ষ থেকে তোমাদের সবাইকে জানাই শুভেচ্ছা ও অভিনন্দন

title.rendered: “Intra-Department Drawing & CAD Contest” organized by Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) ,Dept. of CE

content.rendered:
“Intra-Department Drawing & CAD Contest” organized by Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) ,Dept. of CE

“Intra-Department Drawing & CAD Contest” was organized in Department of Civil Engineering by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) of BAUST on 04.02.2024. Several teams from the department did compete in this contest of preparing a well organized building plan on a given plot area.
Each team consisted of two students. They were directed to prepare a double unit building plan on a A-3 drawing sheet and using AutoCAD tool by fulfilling the given requirements. Each group used the collective knowledge of their team members to fulfill the task.

The result of this contest will be published very soon after proper technical and aesthetic evaluation.

title.rendered: A presentation session on “General Features of A Bridge” organised by Dept. of CE

content.rendered:
A presentation session on
“General Features of A Bridge” was organised by our department on 28.01.2024 (Sunday)

Ahasanul Haque Hashib, Lecturer of Civil Engineering Dept. delivered the presentation on the general and technical features of a bridge and a group students from Level-3, Term-II also shared their experience from a visit of a real bridge near BAUST Campus.
Students got involved in the session actively and participated in the Q&A session spontaneously.
The Controller of Examinations of BAUST Col Farid Sir also joined our session for a short time and also shared his valuable view regarding such sessions.

title.rendered: Introducing Our Teaching Assistant

content.rendered:
Department of Civil Engineering of BAUST cordially welcomes its first Teaching Assistant (TA) MD. ABDUL MALEK who has joined the department on 11 January, 2024.

A. Malek has completed his B.Sc. Engineering from the same department in the semester Summer 2023. He was one of the students of our first batch (10th batch of BAUST) and has achieved first class first position with a remarkable result.

We wish him good luck for his upcoming journey as an honourable member of this department.

title.rendered: Final Thesis Defence of the 1st Batch (10th Batch) of CE,BAUST

content.rendered:
After a year long experiment and research the students of CE 1st Batch (10th batch of BAUST Campus) finally presented their graduation thesis today. There were 14 students who presented their thesis in front of the board of internal and external supervisor’s.
Their thesis covered various aspects of Civil Engineering from Structural, Environmental and Transportation engineering sector.
They incorporated the local technical/engineering issues of north bengal and proposed feasible solution for them.
We believe that, their unique findings will help the scientific community as well as the local policy makers of north bengal to implement the fiscal measures.
The honorable head of the department Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan sir instructed all the students to publish their graduation thesis to a renowned journal within 2 months.
We believe that, our future students of Civil Engineering Department will also create meaningful research for the community using our state-of-the-art laboratory facilities at BAUST.
